context.user_intent: Implement health check and metrics probe endpoint for Bridge Daemon
context.decision_rationale: To support container liveness probes and uptime monitoring, daemon requires a lightweight /health endpoint returning uptime and active task statistics.
context.discussion_summary: Agreed on adding a zero-auth /health route returning JSON status and uptime metrics.

task.title: Add health check and metrics status endpoint
task.description: Implement GET /health and GET /api/health routes on Bridge HTTPServer returning 200 OK with server uptime, daemon version, and active worker pool queue depth.

file_operations.description: Check that /health endpoint is registered and functional

automated_checks.name: Verify bridge module import and daemon class definition
automated_checks.command: python3 -c "from bridge.daemon import BridgeDaemon; assert BridgeDaemon is not None"

manual_verification_steps: Launch daemon on local port and run curl http://127.0.0.1:8765/health
Verify response contains status: healthy and valid uptime_seconds
verification.acceptance_statement: The /health endpoint returns HTTP 200 OK with valid JSON status, version, and server uptime without requiring authentication.
